title: Enforce green Outcome lifecycle gate and direct conversation delivery
outOfScope: Creating or publishing a release version before this Work Item and its existing prerequisite Work Items are complete.

sources.reason: Authoritative Finish and direct Outcome delivery paths.
Existing fail-closed Outcome schema and binding validation.
Archive mutation boundary that currently does not require completed green Outcome.
PR-level archive evidence and report validation boundary.
Lifecycle closure boundary for archived evidence.
Existing direct-output and blocked Outcome regression coverage.
Repository lifecycle rules inherited by the current project.
Installation rules inherited by future adopter projects.
The adopter lifecycle matrix must exercise the same explicit project-quality override path as real installed projects.
First-adoption Summary evidence must explicitly bind its out-of-scope quality limitation so the scoped adoption Outcome can be green without hiding the residual risk.

riskAssessment.reason: The current Finish, archive, PR, and close boundaries were inspected; the change centralizes their shared green Outcome prerequisite.

reasons: Lifecycle terminality and human-visible evidence require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized automatic root-cause remediation and requires the Outcome hard boundary to be enforced in this Work Item.

preReviewWarnings: No terminal lifecycle operation may accept a missing, stale, yellow, red, or non-green Outcome.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A shared Outcome gate requires status=completed and humanStatusColor=green, validates the canonical Outcome Markdown, and verifies the Outcome is bound to the current Work Item Contract, Summary, verification evidence, base, and candidate Head.

ai-finish emits the complete persisted Outcome directly to stdout on every terminal path, including all failure paths; the report contains exactly the canonical traffic-light signal (🟢, 🟡, or 🔴) and retains the non-zero exit code on failure.

Archive, PR validation, and lifecycle close fail closed when the Outcome is missing, malformed, stale, cross-task, yellow, red, or not completed; no archive, merge-readiness, or close claim is produced from such evidence.
Regression tests capture stdout and exercise successful, blocked, malformed, stale, yellow, and green Outcome paths across Finish and lifecycle boundaries.

AGENTS.md and the distributed AI Cockpit rules contain an explicit current-Work-Item remediation rule, restrict successor creation to a genuinely different scope or authority/base, and require a directly visible green Outcome before terminality.
The design and implementation remain project-neutral so future installed adopter projects inherit the same hard gate.
guidelines: Shared lifecycle gates must be documented and tested at every consumer boundary.
Generated status and Outcome artifacts remain derived; do not hand-edit them as a substitute for the authoritative lifecycle path.
Keep the implementation project-neutral so template adopters inherit the same behavior.

intent.problem: Outcome has repeatedly been persisted or summarized without being a complete, directly visible conversation result, and downstream lifecycle gates can still accept a yellow or stale Outcome. That breaks the human trust boundary and allows a Work Item to appear finished before its authoritative human-facing result is complete.
constraints: The complete Outcome is delivered through the conversation-facing stdout stream; stored artifacts and folded tool logs are insufficient human handoff evidence.
intent.rationale: One shared, fail-closed gate prevents each lifecycle consumer from implementing a weaker interpretation, while direct stdout delivery makes the human decision surface explicit and testable.

rawUserRequest: 必须根治 Outcome：Outcome 必须在对话框中完整、独立、明确显示，并带有🔴/🟡/🟢；Outcome 不通过 WI 不准结束。发现问题尽量在当前 WI 修复，只有真正不同范围或权限/基线时才新建 WI；本次目标还包括在既定目标完成后发布新版本。用户授权自动执行并要求将授权写入 Contract。
